purpose: Prevent the general commercial privacy surface on eucons.ro from being mistaken for the AI4WORK research Article 13 notice or processor chain.

current_public_surface.commercial_controller_statement: EUROCONSULT SRL, CUI 14250864 is named as controller for commercial requests.
current_public_surface.commercial_receiver_hosting_statement: The public privacy page states that the commercial-form receiver is hosted separately on infrastructure associated with romania-webhosting.com.
current_public_surface.public_electronic_contact_state: The Contact page states that the company email channel is attached at production activation; no current AI4WORK privacy/DPO electronic contact is thereby established.
current_public_surface.scope_boundary: These public statements describe the general/commercial EUCONS surface and do not by themselves establish the AI4WORK research processor chain.

ai4work_controlled_baseline.research_provider_documentary_baseline: CLAUS WEB Shared Hosting/cPanel DPA v1.0 plus Annex 4 and Annex 5, frozen separately.
ai4work_controlled_baseline.provider_logging_baseline: Claus Web Raw Access field profile frozen separately; actual eucons.ro account archive/retention/access remains to be read back.
ai4work_controlled_baseline.reason: The relationship between the commercial romania-webhosting.com wording and the actual AI4WORK processing path has not been verified.

required_before_prod: verify the actual active processor/subprocessor and hosting path used by the AI4WORK research endpoint and research-only store
verify the current eucons.ro account/server logging, retention and access configuration
freeze an operational EUROCONSULT privacy contact for AI4WORK rights requests
ensure the final AI4WORK Article 13 notice describes the verified research processor chain and does not inherit the commercial receiver statement by assumption
ensure the live general privacy/contact surfaces do not contradict or ambiguously override the dedicated AI4WORK research notice
provider-bound TEST TWIN smoke passes while remaining TEST_TWIN_NON_EVIDENCE
claim_boundaries: Do not infer that romania-webhosting.com is an AI4WORK processor, subprocessor, server or account.
Do not infer that the Claus Web documentary baseline proves the live AI4WORK account path or configuration.
Do not treat the general commercial privacy page as the final AI4WORK Article 13 notice.
Do not infer an operational privacy/DPO contact from historical or unpublished email addresses.
